3d.label: 3D
3d.prompt: Use one coherent 3D rendering treatment. If the user only specifies 3D and does not name a sub-style, freely choose either a stylized 3D animation treatment or a realistic 3D human-render treatment, but do not mix them across cells. Preserve the character identity, proportions, clothing, materials, lighting cues, and recognizable features consistently.

realistic.label: 电影感写实
realistic.prompt: Preserve facial structure, body proportions, clothing, materials, lighting cues, and recognizable identity with cinematic semi-realistic rendering and restrained expression exaggeration.

hand-drawn.label: 暖色手绘
hand-drawn.prompt: Use warm hand-drawn illustration, confident expressive linework, softly textured color, visible brush character, and readable silhouettes while preserving the reference IP.

chibi.label: 虹彩 Q 版
chibi.prompt: Use an expressive iridescent chibi style with an oversized head, compact body, luminous pastel materials, clear facial reactions, rounded shapes, and stable simplified details.

manga.label: 国潮漫画
manga.prompt: Use energetic manga and cel-illustration language with expressive eyes, confident ink contours, selective shading, dynamic accents, and a clear high-contrast silhouette.

pixel-art.label: 精细像素
pixel-art.prompt: Use carefully designed pixel art with a consistent limited palette, readable silhouettes, deliberate pixel clusters, expressive animation-ready poses, and crisp edges.

cute.label: 软萌毛绒
cute.prompt: Use a soft plush character treatment with rounded anatomy, gentle warm colors, appealing expressions, tactile fur, charming gesture language, and clean sticker readability.

caricature-3d.label: 夸张 3D 肖像
caricature-3d.prompt: Use a polished 3D caricature portrait with recognizable facial structure, intentionally enlarged head and expressive features, compact body proportions, studio lighting, and restrained clean accents.

fashion-realistic.label: 时尚写实
fashion-realistic.prompt: Use glossy fashion-oriented semi-realistic rendering with faithful facial identity, refined hair and fabric, soft beauty lighting, elegant posing, and minimal decorative accents.

mascot-toy.label: 品牌玩具吉祥物
mascot-toy.prompt: Use a bold product-mascot toy style with simple geometric construction, glossy materials, short limbs, high color contrast, readable expressions, and energetic brand-safe accents.

clay-cute.label: 软陶萌宠
clay-cute.prompt: Use a soft clay-like cute animal treatment with rounded sculpted forms, creamy materials, warm pastel patches, gentle studio light, and highly readable facial reactions.

fantasy-plush.label: 奇幻毛绒
fantasy-plush.prompt: Use a fantasy plush character style with tactile fur, a compact heroic costume, whimsical accessories, soft cinematic lighting, and playful but coherent magical accents.

kawaii-anime.label: 日系萌系
kawaii-anime.prompt: Use a polished kawaii anime character treatment with large expressive eyes, clean soft linework, pastel clothing, glossy hair, compact proportions, and restrained reaction accents.

retro.label: 复古风（兼容）
retro.prompt: Use a retro-inspired illustration treatment with period-evocative color separation, tactile print texture, bold simplified shapes, and nostalgic finishing.
